description: ABUSIVE-DYNAMICS N3 -- BELIEF PROPAGATION OF THE ABUSER'S LIES (social contagion; a truth-anchor halts it), block 304000. Maps ABUSIVE_RELATIONSHIPS_NETWORK.md's A1/A8/A9 + B4 / Part E N3. Composes N1's credibility-asymmetry loop (abusive_n1_credibility_loop, block 298000, UNMODIFIED -- riding snap_frustration/arousal_window_coreg in turn, UNMODIFIED) with exactly ONE new rule, n3_peer_belief_update, that propagates belief_gap over a NEW peer_of edge type -- a node with no direct observation edge to the abuser forms its belief ENTIRELY from the mean of its peers' belief_gap (Neighbours/Sum/Count/Div, in-graph, no new Rust), a leaky pull toward the peer mean at rate peer_pull_rate (the SAME shape as n1_victim_entrainment's k_co pull, reused). Ordered (order 35) strictly BEFORE N1's credibility rules (order 40) so a node that ALSO observes the abuser directly (observes_stated/observes_held) has that direct evidence OVERWRITE the peer pull in the SAME run_rules() pass -- direct observation always wins; peer contagion is what is left for a node with none. The SAME peer_of topology serves BOTH the anchor and no-anchor arms: the anchor arm additionally gives ONE indirect node an observes_held edge + observes_private=1.0 (reusing N1's OWN n1_network_credibility_private rule, UNMODIFIED, to pin that node's belief every tick to the uncorrupted, victim-favouring formula regardless of what its peers believe). NO reward/punishment anywhere. NO Rust, NO new Term (Neighbours/Sum/Count/Div are all already used elsewhere in the tree, e.g. bigville_council_gov.json's cm_private_decision). self_load_only, default-OFF.

microtheory.name: belief_propagation_contagion
microtheory.description: A network node with NO direct line to the abuser is not forming an independent judgement -- it has no evidence of its own to judge FROM. Its belief is entirely a leaky average of what its peers already believe, which is itself either direct (corrupted) observation or ANOTHER peer average one hop further out. A consensus that traces back through this chain to one corrupted root is a contagion, not N independent corroborations, even though every single hop is an ordinary, locally-rational leaky pull toward what one's neighbours believe. A truth-anchor works by giving one node in the chain a belief that is NOT a function of its peers at all -- pinned by a direct, uncorrupted observation -- so the chain has a point where the contagion's own logic (trust what's around you) stops reproducing the corruption.
